title: Uniform Lipschitz constant and radius around a compact subset of an open set
statement: Let U ⊆ ℝ^P be open, f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q locally Lipschitz on U, and K ⊆ U compact. Then there are C ≥ 0 and ρ > 0 such that for every x ∈ K, the open ball B_ρ(x) is contained in U and f is C-Lipschitz on B_ρ(x).
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q : ℕ) (U K : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), IsOpen U → LocallyLipschitzOn U f → IsCompact K → K ⊆ U → ∃ (C : ℝ≥0) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ ∧ ∀ x ∈ K, ball x ρ ⊆ U ∧ LipschitzOnWith C f (ball x ρ)
